evidence._readme: Decision D3: write access is earned, never asserted. Path evidence is PER OS, because verifying a path on macOS says nothing about Windows — a single global 'captured' would over-claim for two platforms we have never seen.

darwin.how: ~/.claude.json confirmed present on a real installation while running inside Claude Code.

linux.how: Same path is expected, but no Linux installation was available to confirm it.

win32.how: No Windows installation was available. The home base resolves via USERPROFILE (see path-bases.json).

schema.how: Remote-HTTP server shape taken from Claude Code's published MCP documentation. NOT captured from a live entry — no MCP server was configured on this machine to read back.
schema.capture_todo: Configure a real remote HTTP MCP server in Claude Code, read the written entry, compare against http_server_schema, then promote to 'captured' before enabling any repair.

repairs.how: No repair has been round-tripped against a real file.

write_capable._note: Derived, not decided. validate_contract.py fails the build if any of these is true while that OS's path evidence or the shared schema evidence is not 'captured'. Per OS, because a repair is only as trustworthy as the path knowledge underneath it.

locations.note: Checked into the repository and shared with the team. Highest precedence, and the most likely place a bad entry gets committed.
Large multi-purpose file. MCP servers live under the top-level mcpServers key, and per-project under projects.<path>.mcpServers.

server_map._shape_note: An object keyed by server name; the key is the name, the value is the definition.

transport._note: An entry carrying 'command' is a stdio server → scope.stdio-server, out of scope.

headers._accept_note: Claude Code sends its own Accept header, so an explicit override in the config is the only way to break it — which is what config.accept-header-incompatible detects.

identification._readme: How a SuperDocs entry is recognised even when the user named it something else. First rule that matches wins.
identification._host_rule: An entry matched by NAME whose URL host is not api.superdocs.app yields scope.non-canonical-host and is never repaired. Host comparison is EXACT — never a suffix or substring match, or api.superdocs.app.evil.example would pass.

repairs._readme: The exhaustive set of fix kinds permitted for this client. A defect marked auto_fixable still does nothing unless its fix_kind appears in `allowed` AND write_capable is true for the running OS.
repairs._allowed_empty_note: Empty on purpose at delivery step 1: no repair may run until schema evidence is 'captured' and repair fixtures round-trip (step 3).
